en: How to Play Pick-a-Dango{KP}It's a game where you skewer dango on a stick!{KP}Hungry Kintaro-san orders some dango!{KP}And he even demands the order of the colors on his three-color dango!{KP}Make the dango just the way he wants it!{KP}Move Momotaro-san with the directional buttons and skewer the dango on the stick!{KP}Once it's skewered, deliver it to Kintaro-san and it's done!{KP}Skewer the wrong dango and it's a miss!{KP}3 misses and it's game over!{KP}The Circle button changes direction! The X button lets you run fast!{KP}There are also mud dango that make your dango vanish if you bump into them!{KP}Hurry and feed Kintaro-san some dango!

jp: ではゲームスタートです！

　{KN}
en: Would you like to play the game?{KN}

Pick-a-Dango! Here's how the versus game works!{KP}Move with the directional buttons and skewer the dango on the stick!{KP}The Circle button changes direction! The X button lets you run fast!{KP}Make dango within the time limit, and whoever scores more wins!{KP}Every time you finish a stick of dango, mud dango rain down on your opponent!{KP}Make lots of dango in 60 seconds!{KP}1P is Momotaro-san, and 2P is Kintaro-san!
